plans.name: Hire three evening buses
plans.rationale: Three hired buses cover the evening peak at the APU stop. A student advisory encourages leaving before the rush.

plans.name: Online late classes and loop
plans.rationale: Moving late sessions online removes demand from the evening window. The existing fleet runs a nonstop loop at no extra cost.

plans.name: One bus and advisory
plans.rationale: A single hired bus eases the busiest hour while keeping spend low. Students are warned to expect delays.
